lines.text: You copied it an hour ago. Then you copied something else. And now, it's gone.
Meet Stash. Everything you copy, right where you're typing.
Press Command Shift V, and a menu opens at your cursor, with your recent copies. Hit a number, and it's pasted.
Pin the things you type all the time. Control Option one pastes your first pin, anywhere, without opening a thing.
Need something older? Search everything. Filter links, images, code, or colors, and edit before you paste.
Passwords from your password manager are never saved. And it lives quietly, in your menu bar.
Stash. Free and open source, on GitHub.
